title: Impact of Infectious Diseases Consultation Services on Patient Management and Outcome
summary: Not only the appearance of new infectious agents such as SARS-CoV-2, but also the correct diagnosis and therapy of already known infectious agents pose major challenges for practitioners. Within this research project, we want to evaluate data of patients who are in inpatient hospital care and receive a consultant report by an infectious diseases specialist. In addition to general patient's data, data on pre-existing diagnoses, diagnosis of infectious diseases, detected pathogens, diagnostic work up and therapies are evaluated. Further, the patients are contacted by telephone 90 days after receipt of the consultation and data on quality of life and possible recurrences of the disease are collected. By including several study centers, a database is created in order to obtain a more precise overview of the activities and the clinical pictures of the infectious consultancy service at German clinics. Influences of the advisory consultation on performed diagnostics, therapy and the treatment results are analyzed. The implementation of the ID specialist's recommendations is assessed and quantified by developing an adherence score. An examination of the effect of adherence on the treatment results can then be estimated. Evaluation of the point in time when a patient received the ID specialist's consultant report can show a possible significance of the timing to ID consultancy involvement. Ultimately, factors should be identified that are associated with low adherence to the ID specialist's recommendations. In addition, possible quality indicators of the consultant's report, are identified and examined whether their fulfillment also has an influence on the patient's outcome.
conditions: all hospitalized patients receiving a consultation report by a specialist for infectious diseases

interventions.name: Aquisition and evaluation of data on co-medication, previous diagnoses, patient complexity, previous antimicrobial therapies, recommendations of the consultant, adhrence to the recommendation of the ID specialist, fulfillment of possible quality indicators of the consultant's report and outcome of t

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
patients age ≥ 18 Jahre, who are hospitalized and receive an infectious disease consultant report
written informed consent of the participant or of a legally acceptable represantative
Exclusion criteria:
lack of consent to participate in the study
Age <18 years
Death within 24 hours after involvement of the ID consultant service
